info.title: DD Core API
info.description: Stable v1 contract for DD instance discovery, service health, account authentication, contacts, and P4 reliable text messaging/sync. P0 call endpoints remain experimental and are intentionally excluded until promoted into /api/v1.

tags.name: Discovery
tags.description: Instance discovery endpoints used before authentication.

tags.name: Auth
tags.description: Email registration, password login and refresh-token rotation.

tags.name: Contacts
tags.description: Exact handle discovery, contact requests, contact metadata and blocking.

tags.name: Groups
tags.description: Group lifecycle, membership, roles, join approval and ownership.

tags.name: Calls
tags.description: Authenticated one-to-one audio/video call lifecycle and scoped LiveKit join credentials.

tags.name: Messaging
tags.description: Direct, self and group conversations, idempotent messages, read state, recall and cursor-based recovery sync.

tags.name: Media
tags.description: Private media upload reservations, completion verification and short-lived authorized downloads.

tags.name: Stickers
tags.description: Per-user custom stickers and server-relayed Telegram sticker-pack subscriptions.

tags.name: Moments
tags.description: Contact-scoped social feed with per-post visibility, likes, comments and relationship privacy controls.

tags.name: QR
tags.description: Instance-bound user/group QR payloads and one-time confirmed QR login sessions.

tags.name: Governance
tags.description: User-created abuse reports and administrator governance workflows.

tags.name: Admin
tags.description: Independent administrator authentication, MFA, sessions, RBAC and security audit.

tags.name: Data Rights
tags.description: Authenticated user data export and account-deletion lifecycle. Export artifacts are private and downloads use short-lived authorization.

post.summary: Request a private asynchronous export of the current user's data
post.description: Requires a bearer token and Idempotency-Key. Requests inside the server cooldown are coalesced. The durable worker may retry QUEUED/FAILED jobs and reclaim expired PROCESSING leases. Export scope includes profile/privacy, contacts, active group/member relationships, authorized conversation messages, the user's Moments activity, sticker metadata, devices, notification preferences and push endpoint metadata. Raw push capability values and object-storage credentials are never exported.

202.description: Export request accepted or an existing recent request returned

400.description: Idempotency key is missing or invalid

401.description: Access token is missing or invalid

503.description: Data-rights or private object storage is unavailable

get.summary: Get the current user's export status
get.description: The request id is always scoped to the authenticated principal. Another user's id is returned as not found to prevent IDOR enumeration. States are QUEUED, PROCESSING, COMPLETED, FAILED and EXPIRED; retryable indicates whether a durable worker retry is expected.

401.description: Access token is missing or invalid

404.description: Export not found for the authenticated user

post.summary: Authorize a short-lived private export download

401.description: Access token is missing or invalid

404.description: Export not found for the authenticated user

409.description: Export is not ready

post.summary: Request deletion of the current user's account
post.description: Requires bearer authentication, Idempotency-Key, and secondary authentication with currentPassword. The lifecycle starts REQUESTED and is durably transitioned to COOLING_OFF. The user may cancel during the cooling-off window. After it expires the worker enters EXECUTING, revokes devices/tokens/push endpoints, ends active call state, transfers or dissolves owned groups, deletes private business data/objects, anonymizes shared records, then completes as COMPLETED. Recoverable worker failures are recorded as FAILED and retried.

400.description: Request or idempotency key is invalid

401.description: Access token is missing or invalid

403.description: Current-password secondary authentication failed

409.description: Account is not active

get.summary: Get the current user's account-deletion state
get.description: Request ids are principal-scoped. States are REQUESTED, COOLING_OFF, EXECUTING, COMPLETED, CANCELLED and FAILED. Once execution revokes the current device/token, subsequent authenticated polling is intentionally unavailable from that revoked session.

401.description: Access token is missing, invalid, or revoked by deletion execution

404.description: Deletion request not found for the authenticated user

post.summary: Cancel the current user's deletion during cooling-off
post.description: Cancellation is allowed only while the request is REQUESTED/COOLING_OFF and coolingOffUntil has not passed. It is idempotent after a successful cancellation. EXECUTING/COMPLETED/FAILED requests cannot be cancelled.

stickerIds.description: Complete active custom-sticker order for the current user.

mediaId.description: Stable DD media id; Telegram file URLs are never persisted in chat history.

unsupportedStickerCount.description: Compatibility counter for source items that fail validation/import because they are malformed, type-conflicting, oversized, or otherwise unusable. Valid TGS/WebM items are supported and are not counted here.

setName.description: Normalized Telegram sticker set name only. URLs are rejected at the server boundary.

refreshToken.description: Required for native clients. Web clients omit it and use the HttpOnly dd_refresh cookie.
Returned to native clients only. Web clients receive the refresh token only as an HttpOnly cookie.

coverMediaId.description: READY MOMENT_COVER media UUID owned by caller; empty string removes the cover.

nonce.description: Returned only when the desktop/web client creates the challenge; omitted from later status responses.

avatarMediaId.description: READY GROUP_AVATAR media UUID owned by caller; empty string removes the avatar.

userId.description: Stable server-authoritative user binding for a mention.

handle.description: Handle snapshot captured when the entity was bound.

entities.description: Server-generated structured entities. Client-supplied entity bindings are ignored and mentions are rebound from text.

durationMs.description: Duration in milliseconds. VOICE is additionally limited to 250..600000 by message-type validation; VIDEO supports up to 24 hours.

MessageContent.description: Message content fields are validated by message type. Server-owned fileName/mimeType/sizeBytes are derived from the READY media object and cannot be spoofed by the sender.

peerLastReadSequence.description: Direct-chat peer read cursor when the peer allows read receipts; null when hidden or not applicable.

calls.description: Whether this instance exposes LiveKit-backed calling.
